title: If I can view gas-fired furnace curves remotely, can I also operate the equipment from my phone?
summary: Remote viewing, local process settings and door/bogie movement have separate functional scopes. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s gas-fired bogie-hearth furnace proposal dated 6 July 2024 provides computer and mobile viewing of live and stored historical process data. Local controls separately cover process settings, temperature regulation, alarms and movement permissions. Define what can be viewed, where parameters can be changed and which conditions permit movement. Remote monitoring does not establish mobile control of combustion or bogie travel.
